Name: Abigail tweaks
Author: pinzol
Description:
Abi is cool and I love her the way she is, but I always thought that her adventerous nature and her sword-weilding hobby kinda asked for a more fitting hairstyle for these ativities. So, I gave her a ponytail while also adjusting her face just a lil' bit and retexturing outfit.
